faqs.a: Nine services under one roof: digital marketing, creative and graphic design, branding and visual identity, video editing, promotional ad campaigns, web design and development, website and app mockups, and AI automation.

faqs.q: How do I start a project?
faqs.a: Call us or send the quote form on this page. You will talk directly with our founder, we will agree the scope and timeline together, and only then does the work begin.

faqs.q: How long does a project take?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope, and we agree a clear timeline before starting. Business moves quickly, so do we: designs are ready when your campaign needs them.

faqs.q: Do you work with clients outside Dhaka?
faqs.a: Yes. We are based in Dhaka and serve clients across Bangladesh and worldwide, with the whole process handled online, from brief to delivery.

faqs.q: How will I know my marketing is working?
faqs.a: You get straightforward reporting on what ran and what it achieved: reach, traffic sources and leads, in a clear format you can check yourself. No jargon, no inflated claims.

faqs.q: Can I take only design, without marketing?
faqs.a: Of course. Every service can be taken on its own, or combined, so your designs and campaigns are planned together when you want the full package.

pricing_faqs.q: Is ad spend included in the marketing packages?
pricing_faqs.a: No. Ad spend is paid by you directly to Facebook, Google or the platform, so every taka of it goes into your ads. Our package price covers the strategy, setup, management and reporting.

pricing_faqs.q: Can I combine services into one custom package?
pricing_faqs.a: Yes. Most clients mix design, video and marketing into one monthly plan. Tell us what you need and we will build a custom package with a single monthly price.
Monthly packages are billed monthly. Project packages start with an advance payment and the rest on delivery. We confirm the exact terms with you in writing before any work begins.

pricing_faqs.q: Can I upgrade, downgrade or pause a package?
pricing_faqs.a: Yes. Monthly packages can be changed or paused from the next month, and project packages can be extended at any point. There are no lock-in contracts.
